nodes.name: 1. Autonomous Scraper Trigger (Cron 15m)
nodes.notes: Polls streamer feed every 15 minutes autonomously.

nodes.name: 2. Check Feed / RSS (Latest VOD URL)
nodes.notes: Retrieves the latest streamer VOD URL and transcript/chat velocity data.

nodes.name: 3. Video Ingestion Node (yt-dlp Chunk Downloader)
nodes.notes: Executes yt-dlp to selectively fetch a high-engagement 5-minute video chunk into local public folder.

nodes.name: 3b. Whisper Transcription
nodes.notes: Calls whisper-transcribe.js → returns JSON stdout: { captions[], fullTranscript, wordCount }. Parse with: JSON.parse($json.stdout)

nodes.name: 4. LLM Node (Agentic Synthesis & Prompt Generation)
nodes.notes: GPT-4o JSON mode agent synthesizing highlights & constrained B-roll prompts. Receives real Whisper transcript from node 3b.

nodes.name: 4b. B-Roll Image Generation (DALL-E 3)
nodes.notes: Calls generate-broll.js. Extracts every bRollOverlays[].imagePrompt from the GPT-4o JSON, calls DALL-E 3 for each, saves to public/broll/, injects imageUrl paths. Returns: { success, payload, imagesGenerated }. Parse: JSON.parse($json.stdout).payload

parameters.command: =node "C:\Users\USER\Downloads\Ai agent Automation\my-video\render-from-n8n.js" --inline-json {{ JSON.stringify(JSON.parse($node['4b. B-Roll Image Generation (DALL-E 3)'].json.stdout).payload) }} --concurrency 4

nodes.name: 5. Remotion Render Node
nodes.notes: Calls render-from-n8n.js with the LLM JSON payload. Returns JSON stdout: { success, outputFile, durationMs, fileSizeBytes }. Parse output with: JSON.parse($json.stdout)

nodes.name: 6. Discord Approval Gate
nodes.notes: Send and Wait. Attachment path from JSON.parse($node['5...'].json.stdout).outputFile — absolute path from render-from-n8n.js. Message includes title, duration, scene count, and file size from structured render result.

parameters.title: ={{ JSON.parse($node['4b. B-Roll Image Generation (DALL-E 3)'].json.stdout).payload.title }}

nodes.name: 8. YouTube Upload Node
nodes.notes: Title from B-roll payload.title (already parsed). File path from JSON.parse($node['5...'].json.stdout).outputFile — absolute path, no regex needed.
